detailZones.title: Foreground recovery bays
detailZones.description: Inspect the three foreground recovery beds, bedside devices, outlets and privacy fittings.

detailZones.title: Rear recovery bays
detailZones.description: Follow the rear recovery beds, monitor mounts, outlets, curtains, tables and glass separation.

detailZones.title: Nurse communications base
detailZones.description: Inspect the central communications base, observation glazing, corridor hardware and ceiling services.

detailZones.title: Clean utility bay
detailZones.description: Explore the utility sink, dispensers, linen shelves, blanket warmer and supply storage.

detailZones.title: Equipment parking bay
detailZones.description: Inspect the resuscitation trolley, suction, oxygen cylinder, airway cart, mobile imaging and transfer gear.

detailZones.title: Corridor and discharge lounge
detailZones.description: Follow the discharge lounge, corridor handrails, glazing, doors, floor surfaces and transfer supplies.

anchorAudit.rationale: The source and resized PACU photographs were inspected at native and final pixels. This batch retains 134 independently pointable recovery-room beds, equipment, room fixtures and support objects across 6 bounded zones. Patient identity, diagnosis, medication names, clinical readings, recovery outcomes, procedure steps, sterility claims, brands, readable screen content and hidden functions were excluded.
